hints: Follow the extra blood. If blood is leaking from left atrium to right atrium, which ventricle and which large artery will now receive more blood than normal?
Think about mixing. Left atrial blood is oxygenated and right atrial blood is deoxygenated, so what happens to the % oxygenation when they mix on the right side before going to the lungs?
walkthrough:
**Trace the left-to-right shunt**

Think of ASD as a leak from the high pressure left side to the lower pressure right side.

Left atrium loses volume, so left ventricle pumps less blood into the aorta. Right atrium gains volume, so right ventricle pumps more blood into the pulmonary artery.

**Predict the two blood pressures**

More volume pumped into the pulmonary artery means increased pressure there.

Less volume pumped into the aorta means decreased pressure there.

So we need: pulmonary artery increased, aorta decreased. That leaves only C and D.

**Predict the oxygenation in the pulmonary artery**

Normally the pulmonary artery carries deoxygenated blood from the right ventricle to the lungs.

In ASD, oxygenated blood from the left atrium mixes into the deoxygenated blood on the right side. This mixture then goes to the right ventricle and pulmonary artery, so % oxygenation there is increased.

Increased pulmonary pressure + decreased aortic pressure + increased oxygenation = row D.

options.A: Incorrect because extra blood goes to the right side, so pulmonary artery pressure increases not decreases, and aortic pressure decreases not increases.
options.B: Incorrect because although oxygenation is increased, pulmonary pressure should be increased and aortic pressure decreased, the opposite of this row.
options.C: Incorrect because pressures are right but oxygenation is wrong. Mixing oxygenated left blood into the right side raises, not lowers, oxygenation in the pulmonary artery.
options.D: Correct because more blood to the right raises pulmonary artery pressure, less blood to the left lowers aortic pressure, and mixing in oxygenated blood raises % oxygenation in the pulmonary artery.
